title: Neon Survivor: Starry Sky Skiff
description: Pilot your sky skiff through floating cloud waves. Blast geometric rogue drones and harvest radiant energy cores.
synopsis: Top-down celestial sky shooter with 360-degree aiming and upgrading ordnance.
